budget_items.topic: Overtime reimbursement for the Boxborough 9-1-1 arrangement
budget_items.what_was_recorded: State 911 said it can reimburse NVRDD for overtime incurred under the arrangement; no amount was stated.
budget_items.quote: frank pozniak advised that state 911 can provide nvrdd with financial reimbursement for any overtime incurred as a result of this arrangement.

budget_items.topic: Financial compensation concern for taking on Boxborough calls
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Chief Gammel raised that NVRDD communities pay assessments and are concerned about taking on a town with no financial compensation; no figure was given.
budget_items.quote: nvrdd communities pay their assessments, and are concerned with taking on a town with no financial compensation.
